items.title: N5454 Crystal Springs Dr
items.description: Wake up to beautiful, unbeatable water views every day from this 1.56-acre property with 200' of water frontage! This 4-bedroom, 3-full-bath home features a new roof, new LP siding, updated windows, stainless steel appliances, a bright sunroom, and main-floor laundry. The primary suite boasts a large walk-in closet and updated bath with walk-in shower. The versatile main-floor bedroom could also serve as a dining room, home office, or family room. The exposed walk-out lower level features two rec rooms and a cozy gas fireplace. Primary bedroom could be converted back to two separate bedrooms making the property 5 bedrooms. Part of the Crystal Springs Park Association!

items.title: 2131 S 62nd St
items.description: Exceptionally well maintained 3BR bungalow on fantastic double lot, in great location. You'll love the amazing fenced yard and patio. Spacious eat-in kitchen with walk-in pantry. Bedroom and full bathroom on the main level. Living room, dining room and cozy, sunny, bonus entry room, perfect as a den or office complete the first floor. Two bedrooms up. Finished lower level family room and half bathroom, still with plenty of storage space. Detached 2 car garage with additional parking pad. New, tear off roof. Don't miss this one!

items.title: 1627 S 56th St
items.description: Step into the timeless charm of this classic West Allis bungalow, where original character and craftsmanship take center stage. Beautiful woodwork, built-ins, and stunning stained glass details create a warm and inviting feel throughout. The main level offers two spacious bedrooms, a generous living room with electric fireplace, and an elegant formal dining room. A large mudroom welcomes you off the entry and provides excellent everyday functionality. The expansive upper attic 42x18 offers tremendous potential. A huge basement provides abundant storage, while the two-car garage and easy-to-maintain yard complete this charming property. Boiler 2011; water heater 2010. Hardwood flooring under carpets. Make this house your own!

items.title: 1429 Empire Ct
items.description: Tucked in a quiet neighbor hood on a cul-de-sac with a private fenced backyard with a huge cement patio and portable gazebo is this 3 Bedroom, 1.5 bath ranch. Bedrooms have wood floors, kitchen with a breakfast bar and dining area with new patio door leads to the large cement patio in backyard. Basement features a large recreational room finished for entertaining. An exceptional starter home seller includes many home furnishings. Priced to sell fast. Updates Repaired shingles '15, Concrete Patio and Door 23', Main floor laundry hook ups 23', New Windows front side of house 25', Interior and exterior home painting & Landscaping 23', Rec rm remodel and carpeting in basement 23', Dining rm and 1/2 bath 23', AC new motor 17'. Photos may be digitally enhanced. EM held by T and C Title.

items.title: 4134 S Victoria Ct
items.description: Meticulously maintained and updated by original owners: 3 large bedrooms, 3.5 baths, luxury furnishings throughout. The kitchen has quartz countertops, the main bedroom has a spa-like ensuite, and there is a main-level formal dining room, reading room, and family room with an upgraded gas fireplace. Owner installed a Transfer Switch for power continuity, interchangeable with multiple sources like a generator or solar power. The backyard is a multipurpose entertainment space with a full-size bball court, a large cement patio for grilling '16, a treehouse, and French drains for proper drainage. Located on a secluded cul-de-sac. Updates include: Roof '23, AC '24, Furnace '08, WH '21, Triple Sump Pump w/backup, Primarybath '18, Kitchen'18, SS Appliances '18, SS Appli '18. Photos Digitally Alt

items.title: 2753 County Road I -
items.description: Spacious, nicely updated tri-level on nearly an acre of land in the Town of Saukville. Conveniently located, you can easily access Grafton or Cedarburg within just a few minutes. Enjoy dual living spaces & plentiful natural light throughout the entire home. New roof as of 2023 & newer furnace & AC. The main floor offers semi open-concept living between the family room & kitchen. Enjoy a walk-in pantry located off the kitchen w/ tons of shelving. The sunroom on the back of the home extends the living space & even offers heat so that it can be used throughout the year. The lower level has a cozy 2nd living space, w/ a natural stone fireplace. Hardwood floors, spacious bedrooms, & a double vanity bathroom complete the 2nd floor. The private, quiet backyard rounds out this wonderful property!

items.title: 3735 San Fernando Dr
items.description: Welcome to this inviting Brookfield ranch in the highly regarded Elmbrook School District! This 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers comfortable living spaces and a fantastic location on a quiet street. The sunken family room features a natural fireplace and overlooks the backyard, creating a warm and relaxing space to unwind. Spacious living room with freshly shampooed carpet, while all three main-level bedrooms feature beautiful hardwood flooring. The main level has been freshly painted and professionally cleaned, making this home truly move-in ready. The sprawling unfinished basement provides abundant storage and endless potential. Great location close to shopping, dining, parks and more.

items.title: 7429 W Glendale Ave
items.description: Welcome home to this charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath brick home! Step inside to a spacious living room and separate dining room, offering plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, plenty of counter space. The generously sized primary bedroom provides plenty of space to relax. The bathroom offers a large vanity with ample storage. New carpet in living room and bedrooms. Outside, you'll appreciate the 2.5-car garage plus 2 additional parking spaces, providing plenty of room for vehicles, storage, and more. A wonderful place to call home!

items.title: Lt4 Valley Ct
items.description: Fantastic M1 Zoned opportunity, in great location, adjacent to rail. Located between Grafton and Saukville, just off I43. Frontage on Pleasant Valley Rd to maximize visibility. Potential to hook up to Grafton sewer and water.

items.title: W197N17002 Stonewall Dr
items.description: Welcome home to this inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bath upper condo offering a bright, open layout and comfortable living. Private entry welcomes you inside to vaulted ceilings and a cozy gas fireplace. The kitchen opens to the living room and features a breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances and pantry. Generously sized bedrooms and full baths, each with a bathtub, provide plenty of space. Enjoy the convenience of a private in-unit washer/dryer, owned water softener and private balcony. Recent updates include newer carpet and a furnace just one year old. A great opportunity for easy, low-maintenance condo living!

items.title: N1098 St Johns Way
items.description: 2 year old custom modular ranch offering modern comfort & peaceful country living in Oconomowoc School District! This spacious exposed ranch features split bedrooms, walk-in closets, an expansive deck & walk-out lower level. The primary suite boasts a large bedroom, walk-in closet &private bath w/ double-sink vanity& shower surround. The second full bath also features a shower surround. Luxury vinyl plank flooring flows throughout the main level, along w/FF laundry. The kitchen showcases beautiful hickory cabinetry w/ tons of pull-outs. Enjoy an extra-deep 3-car garage39X30, no HOA & a quiet dead-end ST. The extra-tall LL 9ft ceilings full-size windows, a French door to the covered patio, a partially finished full bath & 3rd BR awaiting your finishing touches

items.title: S94W23105 Meadow View Ln
items.description: 3 Bedroom, 2 Bath w/ wood floors large kitchen formal dining area and family room with natural wood fire place. Enjoy morning coffee in the 4 season sun room and entertain on the large refurbished deck with a very generous 1.125 acres. The basement features a recreational room and huge unfinished area for storage or a shop or perhaps more lower level recreational space. The garage is insulated and has professional coating on the floor. The back yard features storage shed with a garage door for your ATV or lawn implement. items.title: 615 Kettle Rdg
items.description: Original owners proudly offer this exceptional Belman-built 5BR, 3.5BA home on 2.15 acres! Grand foyer with soaring ceilings welcomes you to a formal LR/office. Spacious KIT features island, breakfast bar, pantry, desk area, abundant cabinetry, and opens to the DR and sunken GR with GFP. HWFs on most of main, powder room, main floor laundry, sunroom, bed 5 & screened porch. Outside is an entertainer's dream w/a 2-tier deck, pool, gazebo, and built-in grill station with mini fridge. Upstairs offers 4 BRs with new carpet and 2 full baths, including a private primary suite with soaking tub and walk-in shower. Exposed walkout LL features a kitchenette, full bath, rec room, and pool table included. Central vac, quality craftsmanship, and meticulous care throughout. Nothing overlooked!

items.title: 3010 S 96th St
items.description: Welcome home to this well maintained & spacious Ranch home centrally located in the heart of ''Candy Cane Lane'' in West Allis. Natural light pours throughout the entire main level. Enjoy a spacious kitchen, complete w/ loads of cabinet space & plenty of room for a nicely sized dining room table. One of the bedroom closets has been converted to use as main floor laundry. The lower level offers a full bathroom & a large amount of finished living space. Large garage w/ an extra door for easy access to the backyard & a poured concrete patio. Conveniently located near freeway access yet tucked away on a quiet street, this location cannot be beat. Some photos are virtually staged. Hardwood floors under carpet in the living room & bedrooms! Welcome home!

items.title: 3929 Maple Grove Dr
items.description: Beautiful 2 bedroom 2.5 bath townhouse style condo with 2 car attached garage and private entrance. Open concept living on first floor featuring newer plank flooring, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, breakfast bar, gas fireplace, large living room, dining area, powder room and 1st floor laundry. Upper level features 2 bedrooms with 2 full baths. Lower level features a newly remodeled rec room and your own private 2 car garage. Update4s include new flooring in bathrooms, new furnace and a/c in 2025, new kitchen in 2020, new roof in 24. Quiet unit located in back by the walking path. Easy access to highways, close to parks, restaurants, shopping. Easy to show. Pets welcome.

items.title: 688 N Midvale Blvd, 201
items.description: Sophisticated second-level condo in sought-after Hilldale Row Association! Unbeatable convenience--steps from groceries, shopping, and dining. This modern 1-bed, 1-bath unit features sleek flooring, a contemporary kitchen with stainless appliances, under-cabinet and custom ceiling lighting, plus granite countertops in the kitchen, bath, and study. The versatile living area offers space for a home office or cozy retreat. Spacious bedroom with custom closet. Includes in-unit laundry, one parking spot, and storage. On bus lines, minutes to UW, downtown, and hospitals. Stylish, move-in-ready condo in the heart of it all!

items.title: 2941 N 75th St
items.description: Historic charm meets modern amenities in this fantastic Cape Cod located in the heart of Enderis Park & just blocks away from Wauwatosa. Beautifully preserved, you'll find gorgeous historical features upon entering the home. The natural fireplace, hardwood floors, & built-in china cabinet are just some of the wonderful features that you simply cannot find in many other homes. The kitchen was recently remodeled & features plentiful storage space, along w/ a convenient breakfast nook. Finished lower level, complete w/ a partially finished utility room & 1/2 bath. The upstairs attic is an amazing space that could be finished off to add extra sq. footage or even a 3rd bedroom. Other updates include some newer windows & a nearly brand new A/C. Welcome home!

items.title: 5319 69th Dr
items.description: Exceptional contemporary tucked away on wonderful 3+ acre rural, wooded parcel. 1st floor primary suite w/stunning, tiled full bathroom featuring a luxurious walk-in shower. Sunny sunken living room w/wall of windows, open to formal dining space. Second dining space in kitchen w/solid surface counters, breakfast peninsula, & SS appliances. Cozy family room w/lovely brick GFP. Main floor laundry completes the first floor. Four nice sized bedrooms & full bathroom up. Finished walkout LL w/multiple rec spaces, wet bar, & 2nd GFP. Relax on the large deck or the amazing stamped concrete patio. 2.5 car attached garage, PLUS 2.5 car detached garage, AND two garden sheds. Don't miss this one!

items.title: N81W13172 Country Terrace Ln, A
items.description: Lovingly cherished & nicely maintained, this Original-Owner condo is on the market for the 1st time in 30 yrs. You'll Love the privacy & wooded surroundings of this 3BD, 2BA Ranch Style, Side-by-Side, End Unit. You'll feel like you are in the northern woods, yet be so close to everything. The spacious great room offers a focal point/stone floor-to-ceiling gas FP & soaring vaulted ceilings. The patio doors lead to a covered porch that's perfect for your morning coffee. The kitchen features a ton of cabinets, SS appliances, a snack counter for extra seating & a dining area. Primary BD has vaulted ceilings, ensuite & 2 closets. Full BA, 2 other BD's & a laundry room are all on the main floor. 2+ car attached garage is a Plus. Unfinished lower level is just waiting for your finishing touches.

items.title: 617 Evergreen Ter
items.description: 10 Years New, this 3BD, 2BA Custom ''Aspen Home'' in the desirable Woods of White Pines Subdivision has SO much to offer. The split Ranch/Open Concept features 9FT ceilings throughout. The Great Room has a cozy gas FP w/ tranquil views of the tree lined backyard. Gourmet kitchen has a ton of cabinets, a sizeable pantry w/ wood shelving & an oversized island w/ Quartz tops w/ extra seating. The bumped out dinette has a patio door that leads to a 2 tiered deck to relax on & watch the gorgeous sunsets. Primary BD has ensuite w/ a large/custom walk-in closet, dual sinks & a luxurious tile shower. The 9FT ceilings continue to the LL w/ egress windows, a walk-out patio door & is plumbed for an a 3rd BA. This space is just waiting for your finishing touches. Steps away from the neighborhood park.

items.title: 859 Quinlan Dr, H
items.description: Turn-key, spacious end unit overlooking a protected nature preserve. Enjoy low maintenance living, complete with new appliances, fresh paint, new front door, updated fixtures, & a new garage door opener. Several other upgrades, including the furnace & water heater both replaced in the last 6 yrs. Soaring vaulted ceilings & loads of natural light make this unit feel even more spacious. Enjoy gorgeous sunset views on your private balcony that overlooks a nature preserve. Extra ''nook'' space in the living room is perfect for office space, a reading nook, or even just extra living area. Closely located to Pewaukee Lake & all that the charming Village has to offer, this location cannot be beat. Take a look today!

items.title: N7791 Maple Ridge Rd
items.description: Live the ease of condo life with the feel of a single-family home in this move-in-ready ranch-style unit. A private deck and beautifully landscaped yard extend your living space, with rich maple hardwood floors, vaulted ceilings, and abundant natural light. Two gas fireplaces and a sunroom. The finished basement provides a extra room perfect for a home office or workout area. Upgrades: heated flooring in the lower-level bath, video doorbell, and generous storage. Low condo fees and significant recent updates, including a new roof (2024) and new furnace (2025). Kitchen and bath improvements feature granite countertops in the main bathroom, plus newer finishes: refrigerator (2019), water heater (2019), and main-level carpeting (2020). Multiple windows have also been replaced in recent years

items.title: 6497 Sky Ct
items.description: Welcome home to this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home on 1.27 acres in the desirable Slinger School District! Enjoy the space and privacy of a large lot with plenty of room for outdoor activities, gardening, or future additions. A brand-new roof will be installed prior to closing for added peace of mind. Additional updates include a new well pump (2015) and a newer garage door and garage door opener. Don't miss this opportunity to own a home with acreage in a sought-after location!

items.title: 715 Canterberry Ct, 215
items.description: Bright airy freshly updated 2 bedroom 2 full bath condo in 55+ secure building. Unit features spacious rooms open concept, balcony, stainless steel appliances,1 year old water heater and newer floor in master bath. Unit also comes with one stall in the underground heated garage with car washing facilities. Building features work out facilities, community room with pool table, kitchen, fireplace, plenty of room for games and a large covered patio with beautiful views of the surrounding wooded grounds. Secure lobby with common sitting areas on floors 1 and 2 and a nice library on floor 3. Easy to get to and close to shopping, restaurants, parks, churches, etc. Come see it today. Only unit currently available in the building. Unit is now vacant and features some digitally staged photos.

items.title: S54W25469 Pebble Brook Ct
items.description: Luxury meets low-maintenance living in this exceptional 2024 Belman Homes build in sought-after Pebble Brook. This single-family condo offers the space, quality & upscale finishes with less exterior upkeep. Bright, open-concept main level features LVP, white woodwork, 3-panel doors & stylish KIT w/42'' soft-close cabinetry, roll-outs, 2-tone finishes, leathered granite, island, SS appl, RO system & pantry. LR features gas FP & custom electronic blinds. Main-level laundry, mudroom w/custom birch bench, 1/2 BA & solar tubes. Primary suite offers tray ceiling, WIC & heated-floor ensuite w/tiled shower. 2 additional BRs+flex room. Finished LL includes rec room & 1/2 BA. Central vac, Patio, sprinkler system, & heated GAR complete this exceptional home. Located in the Village of Waukesha!

items.title: 836 S 95th St
items.description: Welcome home to this incredibly spacious tri-level home located on a quiet corner directly across from LaFollette Park. Move right in with peace of mind. Nearly all walls & ceilings have been recently painted & all the big tickets items are done. Updates include a new tankless boiler, water softener, A/C, roof/gutters & windows. Enjoy having multiple living spaces & open-concept living on the main level. Attached car garage & a slab for extra parking. Neutral, updated kitchen w/ ample storage space. Additional closet storage in the entry space upon coming in from the attached car garage. Tucked away on a quiet, dead-end street, yet perfectly located close to freeway access & many conveniences across West Allis & even Wauwatosa. Park views throughout the home truly make this one of a kind.

items.title: N9342 21st Ave
items.description: Welcome to your new lake home. Impeccably maintained/updated ranch home featuring open concept w/cathedral ceilings and 2 patio doors leading to a new composite wrap around deck overlooking the calming waters of Golden Sands Lake. Inside features lg great room, family room, gas fireplace, 1st floor laundry with hardwood floors throughout. Home can sleep up to 10 with the right configuration of bunk beds and pull out sofa/day bed. Dry crawl space can be used for storage. Outside you'll find approximately 64 ft of frontage, lg wooded front yard with storage shed featuring a new roof and a back yard with firepit and open views of the lake. Space for a new garage. Just under a 2 hour drive from Milwaukee. Lake is no wake and stocked with fish for catch and release. Nothing to do but move in!

items.title: W52N106 Pioneer Ct, B
items.description: Looking to downsize or maybe just minimize steps in a home? Then this Ranch Style Side by Side condo could be the perfect fit for you. The spacious great room has a stone Gas FP, soaring cathedral ceilings & skylights to let the natural light in. It also has large patio doors that lead to your private/tree lined patio. Kitchen has LVP flooring & a ton of cabinets. Dinette has a bowed window & is adjacent to the kitchen. Primary BD has an Ensuite w/ a step-in shower & a jetted tub. 2nd BD, another full BA & Laundry round out the main floor. Massive unfinished LL can be finished off for more living area or merely used as storage. Your own attached private garage is another perk. So close to everything Charming Cedarburg has to offer...restaurants, shopping, parks & easy I-43 freeway access.

items.title: 3544 S 49TH St
items.description: Charming and refreshed 3-bedroom home with 2 bedrooms on the main level and a third bedroom upstairs, accessed through an unfinished attic loft area. Updates include new carpet, LVP kitchen flooring, fresh paint, and a refinished bathroom vanity. Inviting living room features an updated bay window and brick gas fireplace. Kitchen offers a bay window, window over the sink, and included appliances. Unfinished basement provides ample storage plus a shower, toilet, and vanity--ready for future finishing. 2021 furnace, 2023 water heater, updated front porch, and spacious 2.5-car detached garage complete the property.

items.title: N56W29354 County Road K -
items.description: 3 Bedroom 1.5 Bath ranch w/hardwood floors a three-season recreation room, a natural wood fireplace in living room. kitchen features natural light from a skylight. Huge basement for storage with a crawl space for additional storage. A spacious .5 acre lot with a large backyard for recreation and relaxing with friends and family. Property is situated in the prestigious Arrowhead School District. The prestigious Legend at Bristlecone Golf CC is less then a .25 mile from the house. roof '11, new carpet. '26. Photos digitally enhanced. Owner has not lived in property tenant made inquiries about the following which seller addressed. 3 season porch carpeting (Removed), Chimney near cap was cracked, Sanitary system replaced outlet pipe. 26' Chain n Lock on Septic, replaced risers 26.

items.title: 226 Mertens Ave
items.description: 1st time hitting the market, this tenderly cared for ranch style home has 3BD, 1BA, a partially finished lower level & a 1.5 car garage w/ your own driveway (no alley). Whether you are a 1st time home buyer or a downsizer, this Solid home could be just for you. Special feature is a Generac Generator (for peace-of-mind) that was added in 2020. Garage & House Roof were replaced in 2021. Furnace was replaced in 2026 & A/C is only 1 year old. All your Major items are set for you. All you need to do is add your own personal touches to make this house Your New Home. Close to parks, restaurants, shopping & more. Look to the Documents Tab of the listing for more information about the property & Seller's preferred Closing Date. Welcome Home!

items.title: 3137 S Howell Ave
items.description: Great investment opportunity. Fully leased with great long term tenants. Leases are all month to month. Property is located in the a great Bay View neighborhood across from Humboldt Park and within walking distance of many trendy bars and restaurants. Home consists of two 1 bedroom 1 bath units and two 2 bedroom 1 bath units. Some hardwood floors. The property has a frenced in back yard and off street parking for 4 cars. New tear off roof and gutters in 2021 and new water heater in 2025. Boiler heat is included in the rent, tenants pay their own electric.

items.title: N173W20011 Creekside Dr
items.description: This 3 bedroom, 2 full bath home is located in desirable Highland Creek Farms! The welcoming foyer has hardwood floors that flow into the dining room & the great room. The sunlit great room offers soaring ceilings & a gas fireplace flanked by a wall of windows. The open concept floor plan features an airiness & natural light theme thru- out. The kitchen has loads of cabinets, under-cabinet lighting, SS appliances & the dinette is surrounded by windows with sliding glass doors leading out to the private patio. The split Ranch design includes a primary en suite w/walk-in closet, dual vanities, jetted soaking tub & shower. The BIG lower level awaits your ideas to create your own retreat. Garage has epoxy floor, roof new in 2020, A/C 2018. Just move in & enjoy!

items.title: 3028 Tanglewood Dr
items.description: Beautifully maintained & Move-In Ready, this stunning split ranch in the sought after Rivers Crossing Subdivision has 4BD's & 3BA's. The Open Concept layout features a gorgeous kitchen w/ granite countertops, center island w/ seating, a ton of cabinets & SS appliances. The cozy great room has a gas FP to relax by. There's a dining area for more formal occasions. Spacious Primary BD has a luxurious ensuite w/ dual sinks & a large walk-in closet. 2 other BD's & a laundry room round out the main floor. The finished LL has an amazing Theater Room, Kitchenette, Exercise Room, Full BA & 4th BD. Plus there's still plenty of storage space in the unfinished area. Enjoy your morning coffee on the outdoor patio that overlooks neighborhood pond. Look to the documents tab for info about the property.

items.title: 1300 N 70th St, 1302
items.description: Great investment opportunity or owner occupant 2/2 duplex in the heart of Wauwatosa. Property is currently leased with great tenants who take pride in their living quarters and it shows throughout. Gleaming hardwood floors, built-in buffets with original stained glass doors, natural woodwork on first floor, coved ceilings in dining rooms, and movable islands in the kitchens included. Bright airy upper unit with front patio. Outside features a nice deck, garden shed and off street parking for at least 4 cars. Basement has plenty of storage and includes a washer and dryer with hookups for another set if desired. Close to Hart Park, downtown bars, restaurants and shopping. Set up showings thru Aligned Showings with a strict 24 hour notice required. (measurements are estimates)

items.title: 3680 E Fitzsimmons Rd
items.description: Look no further than this conveniently located 1 acre lot in the heart of Oak Creek. Enjoy being close to many modern conveniences & amenities, yet being tucked away to provide a more rural & private feel. Heavily wooded, flat lot perfect for many different possibilities. Located within 10 minutes of freeway access, the popular Drexel Town Square & even closer to Lake Michigan, this location cannot be beat. Many walking trails located nearby, including the popular Bender Park Hiking Trail. With low inventory, this could be the perfect opportunity to build your dream home!

items.title: 7343 Glencoe Dr
items.description: Well maintained & tenderly cared for, this 4BD, 2.5BA Ranch home is on almost an acre in the Town of Cedarburg. The stunning curb appeal will catch your eye 1st. The kitchen offers updated cabinetry, a convenient snack counter & skylights that bring in a ton of natural light. The Dining area has a large Bowed window that faces the private backyard. The sunken front living room is a great place to relax. Dining room is ideal for more formal occasions. The family room has an eye catching NFP & soaring vaulted ceilings. There are also patio doors leading to backyard. Primary BD has ensuite & double closets. 3 other BD's, a laundry room & 1/2 BA round out the main floor. Unfinished lower level is waiting for your finishing touches. Relax on the large deck & admire your tree lined backyard!

items.title: 41 Main St
items.description: Rare mixed use commercial space just outside the Horicon Wildlife area. 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom home, attached to commercial building with kitchen, perfect for a bar/restaurant. Currently leased by D&D Pub Pizza. In addition, the property includes a dam that provides electrical power sold to Alliant Energy. Transfer Application required. Wonderful views of the Rock River and Kekoskee Millpond from both the front and back of the property. A myriad of possibilities and a once in a lifetime opportunity!

items.title: 5820 E Waterford Rd
items.description: This one of a kind custom Spanish Mission Revival home sits atop 5.25 acres on a private wooded lot where nature & serenity exist!Step inside & find attention to intricate details w/coffered ceilings, arches, wrought iron, marble & granite accents. This carefully designed architectural wonder offers windows galore!The large sunlit Great Rm has soaring ceilings, gas FP w/exterior chimney featuring a bell tower design. The KIT has a 2nd FP w/dinette accessing front patio. Cozy library compliments home office/BR. The ENTIRE 2nd floor is devoted to the primary en suite w/loads of closets, separate dressing area & beautiful bath w/jetted soaking tub, walk-in shower & dual vanities. 3rd floor is a private get away w/walls of windows for awesome views. Brand new generator, A/C & furnace 2024
